title: The Lost Colony of Roanoke
hook: In the late 1500s, an entire English colony vanished from Roanoke Island.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In 1587, over a hundred settlers arrived at Roanoke Island under John White.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The colony's governor, John White, left for England in August 1587 to gather supplies.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: When White returned in 1590, he found the settlement deserted, with 'CROATOAN' carved on a post.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: Nearby Croatoan Island, now Hatteras Island, showed no sign of the colonists despite extensive searches.

beats.label: THEORY
beats.line: One theory suggests the colonists integrated with the Croatoan tribe, abandoning the English settlement.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent DNA analysis of modern Hatteras residents revealed a possible 17th-century English genetic link.

end.line: What really happened to the Roanoke settlers after 1590?

description: Explore the mysterious disappearance of the Roanoke Colony and the clues left behind.
